description: Source code for IO base functions used in compressing/uncompressing ZIP files with zlib, including file operation callbacks and platform-specific adjustments.

methods.name: fopen_file_func
methods.description: Opens a file with mode determined by input flags, used as callback for file opening.

methods.name: fread_file_func
methods.description: Reads data from a file stream, used as callback for reading.

methods.name: fwrite_file_func
methods.description: Writes data to a file stream, used as callback for writing.

methods.name: ftell_file_func
methods.description: Returns current position in file stream, used as callback for tell.

methods.name: fseek_file_func
methods.description: Seeks to a position in file stream based on offset and origin, used as callback for seek.

methods.name: fclose_file_func
methods.description: Closes a file stream, used as callback for close.

methods.name: ferror_file_func
methods.description: Checks for file error, used as callback for error handling.

methods.name: fill_fopen_filefunc
methods.description: Initializes a zlib file function structure with the above callbacks.
